Property Taxes
Overview
The County Auditor computes taxes according to the levies and spreads the same upon the tax rolls; figures interest and penalties on delinquent taxes; and after payment, apportions and disburses the proceeds to the various governmental subdivisions.
Please refer to your statement stubs for due dates.
Checks should be made payable to: Winona County Auditor-Treasurer.
Place your check and remittance advice(s) or stubs in our drop box located on the East side of the County Office Building, near the Washington Street public entrance doors; or
Mail your check and remittance advice(s) or stubs to:
Winona County Auditor-Treasurer
202 W Third Street
Winona, MN 55987
You can also Pay online with a credit card (2.4% convenience fee), debit card (1.5% convenience fee), or electronic check (flat $1.50 fee).
Note: Fees are charged by the company Winona County uses to handle credit card transactions. Winona County does not charge a fee nor does it receive any of the fee amounts charged to you.
Winona County also offers automatic ACH for tax payments. This will take the funds from your chosen account on the due date. Please contact the Auditor-Treasurer's office for more information if you are interested in this option. (507) 457-8830.
Need a duplicate tax statement? The last few years' statements can be found online using the instructions below:
Click the Pay online link here or on the main page of Winona County's website. (You may get a pop up saying you are now leaving this site. That is ok. The link takes you to Winona County's Beacon page where property information is displayed.)
From there you can find your parcel by entering the parcel/property ID (found on your tax statements formatted as xx.xxx.xxxx - enter only the numbers.) You can also search by the property address.
Once you have found your parcel, scroll down and you will find a Tax Statement section with PDF links to the last few years of statements.
